answers.name: Restock Alert
answers.description: Lets shoppers ask to be emailed when a sold-out product is back in stock, so merchants recover lost sales.
answers.functionalities: Show a 'Notify me when available' form on sold-out product variants; Store each shopper's email request per variant; Email shoppers automatically when the variant is restocked; Show the merchant a list of requests and how many were sent
answers.flow: The merchant installs the app and adds the notify block to the product page. A shopper on a sold-out variant enters their email. When the merchant restocks it, the app emails everyone waiting and marks their requests as sent.
answers.plans: Starter: $0, up to 50 alert emails a month; Growth: $15/month, 14-day trial, unlimited alert emails, custom email text

mentions.label: an inventory or product webhook for restocks

criteria: Shopper emails are deleted or anonymised when Shopify sends customers/redact and shop/redact.
customers/data_request returns the shopper emails the app stores.
The storefront form is protected against spam or abuse (for example rate limiting or a honeypot).
The Starter plan's 50-emails-a-month limit is counted and enforced on the server.
Emails go through a transactional email provider (named, or left as an open question for the merchant) with its credentials in environment variables.
